title: Prove sharp two-for-one terminal rank capacity (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration: the binary terminal return-stock bound `min(b+s,b+2h)` is sharp for every even `b`, with fixed maximal source libraries and at most `h` changed unmarked arrivals. The new attaining exchange is

```text
unmarked u -> p+q
marked   p -> u       difference p+u
marked   q -> q+u     difference u
```

The three final arrivals form a basis. The two marked differences are independent modulo the new unmarked span. Direct sums attain the bound; a synthetic 523+22 instance reaches stock 22 with five changed arrivals and preserves terminal rank 545, including the base support partition 3+3+2+4.

ToikY #7258 supplies the credited dimension-only upper bound and motivating altered-arrival question. The new result is its sharpness construction, not a recheck of that package. A stronger obstruction must use actual libraries, donor projections, scheduling or costs. [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19542414).

## Evidence

Before, the dimension argument supplied a five-arrival necessary condition without an attaining abstract construction. The new proof and verifier attain that condition in the declared maximal-library relaxation.

CPython 3.12.15 local checks passed on 825 small construction cases, six 545-dimensional synthetic witnesses, and all 26,286 assignments across ten complete small singleton models. Independent elimination and span-cardinality ranks agree. Four mathematical controls and three invalid-parameter controls pass. Normal and optimized warning-strict receipts agree, with result SHA-256 `9d319389498ee9feea465fc7cf4d578b996320a41690919c0a0369dd6fb5fa38`. Each registered check was timed locally at under one second.

Metadata/pins, exact committed bytes, modes and source ancestry passed. A six-file read-only Git-free export replay with an empty PATH produces the identical receipt. No predecessor scientific verifier ran.

From the checkout root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -W error scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-terminal-two-for-one
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -W error research/bit-terminal-two-for-one/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-terminal-two-for-one --check-modes --check-source-history
```

The registered runner executes both normal and optimized commands. The verifier prints a generated receipt bound to all six package files. Its optional `--receipt` path must be outside the checkout.

## Limitations

The libraries are synthetic. This does not assert stock 22 on the actual BIT word or give a chronological implementation, restored named endpoint, physical tariff, complete supplier, improved kappa or selected-frontier change. Free final-basis reconstruction is part of the relaxation. The theorem is over F_2; it fails over F_3. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Native, compiler, physical caller, tape, selected cold replay, independent human review and formal proof-kernel acceptance are unclaimed and unrun.

## Open next questions

Can funded changed paths or expanded marked libraries realize one such exchange with actual payloads and distinct eligible terminal ports? Use #7260's source-pinned donor map as a cited input, then enforce the shared U component, quotient projections, joint endpoint and complete timed/owned bill. Do not repeat its census. These obligations do not follow from this abstract attainment.

## Related open work

- #7258 fixes the actual marked libraries and derives the motivating dimension bound. This contribution proves sharpness with maximal synthetic libraries; it does not compute its literal stock.
- #7260 bounds actual old-source unmarked donor stock and separately charged refinements. Its source restrictions are absent from the sharpness relaxation; no same-instance numerical comparison is claimed.
- #7209 studies individually restored same-chart transfer at the marked BIT terminal banks. The new exchange grants joint terminal-basis reconstruction and arbitrary unmarked payload changes.
- #7200 excludes cached strict-prefix BIT donors. This construction supplies no such cached donor or physical path.
- #7244 proposes a complete complex-side improvement and motivates the BIT target in #7258. This package supplies no complete invoice or competing kappa.

The closeout own-open-PR check found eight other contributions created since the CLAIM. None studies this terminal return-stock capacity question; no additional same-object entry or numerical comparison was needed.

## CI notes

CI did not certify this package at unchanged head `19f6c9e5962ae11519661d070c3bdcd3aa6537a3`. In [run 43029427643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029427643), [plan job 130552352656](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029427643/job/130552352656) failed in `Onboarding helper tests` on exactly `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped. Its AssertionError says that `` `make frontier7000-verify` `` was not found in the CI verification doc. The [package replay job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029427643/job/130554606823) was skipped because `plan` failed.

The cause is inherited from main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`: `certificates/selected-result.json` names `make frontier7000-verify`, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still describes #6030 and `make frontier6030-verify`. Both main files were inspected. The record, doc and failing test are unchanged at this PR head.

I read the failed-job logs for each comparison below and confirmed the same sole failing test, missing-command assertion, 760 tests, one failure and 24 skips:

- [42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314)
- [42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790)
- [43024693032](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43024693032)
- [43029125610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029125610)
- [43029249083](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029249083)

All scientific checks listed above passed locally. No fix, retrigger commit, push or job rerun was made. Hosted package replay remains unrun.

## Credit

The exchange, sharpness proof and standalone verifier were produced by Nick Petalas. Credit ToikY #7258, exact head `90a63fbefcf79c3e0c0453ef0741dff8517b6167`, for the upper bound and open altered-arrival route; Jerry Chen / CubeJerry #7001/#6726 and their retained contributors for the BIT word; Clear1nsight #7244 for the complete comparator. Binary elimination, rank-nullity and direct sums are classical. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** package

Six new scoped package files; shared execution and selected-result files are unchanged.
